name: echo napoleon
description: Proposal after Jacques-Louis David, Napoleon Crossing the Alps (1801), 40 cell lattice (12 px cells): a bigger creature in deep teal plays the rearing horse, a long body on four legs with an ECHO head side on (a visor band, one eye slit, an antenna for an ear) and a mane and tail streaming in ping, and the family creature at 1x rides it upright with a gold cape billowing out to the right on the wind, under a grey storm sky with dark cloud banks sliding right, over a dark rock slope; the horse stands half reared with the arm down, rears higher with its front legs folding while the rider's arm on our right comes up to point straight up the pass with a bright glove, both antennas ping, the rider's eyes shut happy at the top while the front legs kick, and it eases back down; judge whether it reads at a glance as the painting, whether the bigger creature reads as a horse and still as ECHO, and whether the pointing arm reads at 12 px cells.
